executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd();R74='reports/research/510300_original_operation_reasons_dr007_response_v1';R='reports/research/510300_fiscal_reason_month_end_dr007_comparison_v1';OUT=ROOT/R;OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
a=json.loads((ROOT/R74/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));assert a['experiment_id']=='E74' and a['new_model_fits']==0
fiscal=[z for z in a['included_specific_tag_groups'] if z['included_original_tag']=='FISCAL_SPENDING'];assert len(fiscal)==3 and fiscal[-1]['n_announcements']==28
parents=[R74+'/protocol.json',R74+'/result.json',R74+'/全部常规公告_H0_H1_H5原DR路径.csv',R74+'/所有原公告理由句作用对象_词类非纯原因.json']
o={'study_id':'510300_FISCAL_REASON_MONTH_END_DR007_FIXED_COMPARISON_V1','experiment_id':'E75','registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'status':'REGISTERED_ONCE_FISCAL_REASON_CALENDAR_EXPLANATORY_COMPARISON_AFTER_E74_NOT_INDEPENDENT','question':'E74含财政支出原标签的H5多下降，是否主要共现于月末资金价格回落？先作唯一固定日历位置解释对照，不以结果造策略。','selection_history':'在已见E74六个具体标签的全部H0/H1/H5后提出本解释问题，保留已见历史与选择过程，不叫独立验证或预先收益假设。','fixed_population':'E74全部1767原常规/明确不操作公告；全部28含财政支出标签事件及其全部三期限都保留，其他1739公告为未写此标签对照，不叫没有财政影响。','calendar_definition':'原自然月最后5个日历日=公告日期距本月月末0—4天；复用旧自然月末5日口径，不根据结果改窗口，不用未来股市休假状态。','single_matching_rule':'对每份原财政公告，取全部同自然年、同自然月、同是否月末5自然日、未写FISCAL_SPENDING原标签的原公告。全部可用对照不挑相邻/最好日，0对照则UNKNOWN且保留本事件，不换年月/窗口。','comparisons':'全部H0/H1/H5：含标签与未写标签×月末状态原描述；逐财政事件减其固定匹配全部对照均值，原基准DR007水平差另列。不回归/参数网格/显著性扫描，不按价变选类。','limits':'年份/月末位置不控制基准利率水平、真实现金流/操作内生性、假日和其他同期信息；对照复用/响应重叠非独立。前日利率未认证在公告9点前交付；研究仅历史资金价格。','new_stock_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_network_requests':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'source_code_edits':0,'parameter_grids':0,'source_reason_field_not_filled':True,'old_rejections_preserved':True,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'goal_achieved':False,'parents':[{'path':f,'bytes':(ROOT/f).stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(ROOT/f)} for f in parents]}
f=OUT/'protocol.json';assert not f.exists();f.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'E75':'先登记原28财政公告全部三期限与固定同年月/月末状态对照','窗口':'原最后5自然日固定不调','新模型/标签/账户/网络/源码':0},ensure_ascii=False))
